purpose: Mark a change that has already happened or request more.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
もう + completed predicate; もう + quantity.
I have already finished my homework.
I will not work any more today.
formation: もう + completed predicate; もう + quantity.
restrictions: With a negative predicate it often means no longer; with a quantity it can mean another.
mistake: Interpret もう through the predicate and context.
